grammar.title: Even more with 更加
grammar.explanation: 更加 (gèngjiā) means "even more" — a more formal, written version of 更, used to show an increase compared to before. It goes right before the adjective or verb being intensified.

sentences.zh: 这让我更加喜欢中国文化。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè ràng wǒ gèngjiā xǐhuan Zhōngguó wénhuà.
sentences.en: This makes me like Chinese culture even more.
